name: Tougasaki Haruhime
source:
A third-year student at St.Trea Academy. She is the president of the puzzle club. She is a quiet and intelligent girl. She is full of maternal love and likes to take care of others.

She is shy and cannot talk to people she doesn't know, but when she takes the time to get to know them, she will enthusiastically engage in conversation. 

As she gets to know the [url=/c121601]protagonist[/url] better, she develops a romantic attraction and desire to devote herself to him.
